digest.component_or_area: pytest test infrastructure / temporary fixture management
propositions: Nested pytest sessions without explicit --basetemp join the user-global numbered temp root and trigger cleanup of unrelated temporary directories at session finish.

tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py and tests/unit/test_scripts_import_convention.py execute nested pytest children that allocate shared numbered roots through repository autouse fixtures without private basetemp isolation.

Pytest 9.1.1 TempPathFactory.getbasetemp creates and registers cleanup handlers for numbered roots; pytest_sessionfinish only skips cleanup when _basetemp is None, causing children without --basetemp to delete cleanup-eligible parent or sibling trees.

Parent pytest processes must pass a unique child-specific basetemp path (e.g., tmp_path/child-name) via --basetemp to each executing nested subprocess to prevent cross-session temp root contamination.

Safe executing nested launchers already exist at tests/_store_isolation.py and tests/unit/test_external_isolation.py that pass parent tmp_path-derived basetemp values; collect-only and pytester-managed launchers do not trigger the defect because they never allocate TempPathFactory._basetemp.
